decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and installing new building pressure/vacuum relief valves.

items.material_name: Building pressure/vacuum relief valve, ±650 Pa, minimum 900 m³/h, minimum grade 1.4301 stainless steel housing, for DN 200 piping
items.description: Maintenance-free safety valve with a matching branch and connection hardware for installation in DN 200 stainless steel piping.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new thermal mass flowmeter assembly with a calibrated precision measuring section.

items.material_name: DN 200 thermal mass airflow meter with 350 mm flanged measuring section, 0–10,000 Nm³/h, IP65, 24 V DC, 4–20 mA
items.description: Compact meter with a fouling-resistant sensor, 0.5-second response, and a calibrated DIN EN 1092-1 Form A flanged measuring section.

decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and assembling a new big bag discharger; the dosing valve and support stand are included components.

items.material_name: BBE-2.1-type low-profile 1.4301 stainless steel big bag discharger, for bags up to approximately 120 × 100 cm, 1190 mm frame height
items.description: Includes a 350 mm gas-spring lift, long manual BIDV-7.1-S-S rope iris dosing valve, and approximately 1200 mm support stand.

decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and installing a new stationary liquid jet solids pump.

items.material_name: Stationary FFeP-type liquid jet solids pump, reference 181001 473195
items.description: Stationary jet pump for conveying solids with a motive liquid, supplied ready for operation after installation.

decisions.reason: The position requires supplying a new water jet air ejector; the included testing, documentation, and commissioning do not change that.

items.material_name: DN 150 water jet air ejector, 60 m³/h motive water, welded 1.4571 stainless steel, DN 100 PN 16 inlet, DN 150 PN 10 outlet
items.description: Vertical ejector for raw well water deacidification and aeration, with DN 80 throttle valve and 120 Nm³/h design air intake.

decisions.reason: The position requires new filter nozzles to replace the removed nozzles and states the quantity per filter.

items.material_name: S3-type air-cushion stem filter nozzle, minimum 2 mm air slot and working bore, minimum 5 mm height adjustment
items.description: Replacement nozzle for an open filter underdrain, with burr-free air slot and working bore.

decisions.reason: The position requires two distinct new filter media layers, each with its own amount per filter.

items.material_name: DIN 12904 washed and fire-dried quartz support gravel, 2.00–3.15 mm, 30 cm layer
items.description: Graded quartz gravel forming the support layer beneath the arsenic removal medium.

items.material_name: GEH 102 granular ferric hydroxide arsenic adsorption medium, 1.20 m layer
items.description: Arsenic removal medium supplied in ten 830 kg bulk bags per filter for hydraulic placement.
